description: Rename a QR code, change where scans go, or change its colors. A new destination also applies to postcards already mailed with this code. Templates pick up new colors at send time.

background_color.description: Hex color, e.g. #111827. Keep strong contrast with the background so phones can scan it

destination_url.description: Where a scan sends people, e.g. https://acme.example/offer (https:// is added if missing)

foreground_color.description: Hex color, e.g. #111827. Keep strong contrast with the background so phones can scan it

name.description: New name for the QR code

title: Edit QR code
